troyruins.name: Troy
troyruins.slogan: Nine cities stacked on one windy hill above the plain.
troyruins.line: Excavations by Heinrich Schliemann began in 1870 and revealed nine layers, Troy I to IX; UNESCO listed the site in 1998.

anzaccove.name: Anzac Cove
anzaccove.slogan: A strip of shingle where Anzacs gather at dawn.
anzaccove.line: You are now lying in the soil of a friendly country. Therefore rest in peace.
anzaccove.by: Words attributed to Atatürk, 1934, carved at Anzac Cove

sehitlerabidesi.name: Çanakkale Martyrs' Memorial
sehitlerabidesi.slogan: Four great pillars holding a roof over the Gallipoli peninsula.
sehitlerabidesi.line: The 41.7-metre memorial won a design contest in 1944 and was opened on 21 August 1960.

cimenlikkalesi.name: Çimenlik Castle
cimenlikkalesi.slogan: Mehmed's waterside fort, now a naval museum with old guns.
cimenlikkalesi.line: Built under Mehmed II to guard the Dardanelles, it was strengthened by Suleiman the Magnificent in 1551.

kilitbahirkalesi.name: Kilitbahir Castle
kilitbahirkalesi.slogan: The clover-shaped lock on the Dardanelles, facing its twin across the water.
kilitbahirkalesi.line: Mehmed the Conqueror built it in 1463 with a sister fortress opposite, to control the straits at their narrowest point.
